mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (department_id, username, password_hash, display_name, email, mobile, status, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{departmentId}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{email}, #{mobile}, #{status}, #{lastLoginAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET department_id = #{departmentId}, username = #{username}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, display_name = #{displayName}, email = #{email}, mobile = #{mobile}, status = #{status}, last_login_at = #{lastLoginAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code FROM user_role ur INNER JOIN role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE r.role_code WHEN 'ADMIN' THEN 1 WHEN 'SUPER_ADMIN' THEN 2 WHEN 'SYSTEM_ADMIN' THEN 3 WHEN 'MANAGER' THEN 4 WHEN 'KB_MANAGER' THEN 5 WHEN 'DOC_EDITOR' THEN 6 WHEN 'AUDITOR' THEN 7 WHEN 'USER' THEN 99 ELSE 50 END, ur.id LIMIT 1
